stem.text: The graph shows the diameter of a tree trunk at different times.

stem.alt: Graph of diameter of tree trunk in arbitrary units against time of day from 24:00 to 24:00: diameter falls to a minimum at 12:00 and rises again; points X, Y and Z are marked

A.text: X shows the expansion of the trunk as water fills the xylem during transpiration.

B.text: Y shows a reduction in diameter of trunk as water is lost from the xylem due to transpiration.

C.text: Y shows a reduction in diameter of trunk due to water held in tension in the xylem.

D.text: Z shows the expansion of the trunk as the phloem tissue acts as a sink at night.
